insight.headline: Password Protected Shop Dev flows on Shopify Theme CLI v3.83.x and older to be deprecated
insight.what_changed: Starting October 1, 2026, Theme commands on Shopify CLI for password protected storefronts will require version 3.84.0 or later. Versions 3.83.x and earlier will no longer be supported for theme development workflows on password protected storefronts.
